kxexe01.title: Why does the Moon follow my car?
kxexe01.caption:
Drove home from my ex's and the Moon followed me the whole way.
It's so far away its direction barely changes, so it seems to keep pace. Big feelings work the same: let them ride along, and they set.

kxexe02.title: Is the Moon leaving us?
kxexe02.caption:
No fight. We just stopped texting.
The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm a year, and most friendships drift just as quietly. The pull back is small too: one text.

kxexe03.title: Why do stars twinkle but planets don't?
kxexe03.caption:
Sparkly one week, gone the next.
Stars twinkle because of the moving air between us, not the star. Mixed signals are often static too: skip the guessing and ask one clear question.
